scenario.title: 55.0 V is a flat battery when parked and a fault when driving
scenario.description: Inject 55.0 V — five volts under the limit — while the pack is idle, and require no fault at all, with the pack's own console confirming it sits in standby with the contactor open and no fault code. Restore the pack, bring HV up, then inject exactly the same 55.0 V under load and require the fault frame to carry UNDERVOLT inside 50 ms. The fault must then survive the pack recovering, because rule 3 is latched.
